criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief. Required: Continuous enclosed natural oval carbonate tube with complete roof, walls and floor between two truncated module ends; Visible interior with unequal scalloped dissolution hollows and broad flattened floor, not uniform symmetric pipe; Original short passage module with two deliberately exposed artificial cut-end boundaries, not a natural cave entrance or open arch. Scope: Generic original solution-cave passage module informed by NPS Cleveland Avenue tube photograph and primary cave-process text. Not exact Mammoth Cave geometry, DEM, site reconstruction, lava tube, natural entrance or unmodified photographed tour path. Continuous enclosed passage is truncated at front and rear to expose its interior; these are artificial module boundaries, not geological openings. Nominal10x12x5.4m illustrative full-volume carbonate shell with roughly8x3.4m inner section. Outer envelope and hidden thickness are artistic; actual cave wall dissolution morphology guides interior only. No age, locality or ecosystem asserted.

Visible interior with unequal scalloped dissolution hollows and broad flattened floor, not uniform symmetric pipe

concept_decisions: Retain complete roof between two end planes, thick enclosing shell and interior scallop recesses. Concept image is front-exposed module; do not convert to missing-roof cutaway. Short enough that front and rear internal geometry genuinely visible without render-only hidden surfaces. Cross section asymmetric broad oval with mildly flattened floor, not circular hose. Multiple unequal smooth-edged faceted scallops are recessed into wall mesh, no pasted hemispheres. Actual Cleveland photo has tour trail/edging/lights: omit these human features rather than claim untouched exact morphology. Same neutral material must still reveal scallops.
intended_use: Static geological educational module at256-512px; world scale preserved.
